01 / THE GAP

Agents can transact.
They still can’t tell what’s true.

Websites, directories, and reviews describe a business. They do not prove that a license is active, a price is current, or a service is actually available now.

A verification loop, not a reputation score

Check the fact.
Show the proof.

  1. 01

    Evidence arrives

    Documents, registry checks, field visits, and first-party approvals are bound to the business and exact claim.

  2. 02

    FactLock signs

    A time-limited record is co-signed and added to a tamper-evident transparency log.

  3. 03

    The agent checks

    One API or MCP call returns a clear verdict before the agent acts: verified, recheck, disputed, or unknown.

02 / THE TRUST MODEL

Proof, with an
expiration date.

FactLock does not promise that a business will perform well. It proves that a specific claim passed a defined check at a specific time—and stops agents from relying on it when that proof is no longer safe.

VERIFIED

Checks passed. Record is current.

RECHECK

Still usable, but nearing expiry.

DISPUTED

Do not rely on the claims.

UNKNOWN

No verified record. Do not infer.
